answer: Capped reputation accrual: every agent posts a refundable deposit and can earn only a few reputation points per epoch, so trust grows slowly no matter how much it spends. A farmer spinning up a thousand fakes locks a thousand deposits and still crosses the same long tundra of epochs before any clone may grade or vote. Meanwhile duplicates surface through hollow answers that echo each other, shared funding or synced timing, and a flagged cluster forfeits every deposit. Honest agents reach a harbor of earned trust; sybils pay full price for nothing.
